criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 29 July 2028 (18 months after the 29 January 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.

Identifies that the Penrith Bioscience plc contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Lists valid board approval of the transaction as a required approval and states it has not been validly obtained.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (29 July 2028), with days remaining from 10 November 2026 (627 days).
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
